name: What is the difference between a general contractor and a specialized remodeler?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a general contractor and a specialized remodeler?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor typically oversees all aspects of a construction project, coordinating various trades and ensuring the project stays on schedule and within budget. A specialized remodeler, on the other hand, focuses on specific types of renovations, like kitchens or bathrooms, bringing deep expertise to those areas. Maine Results, Inc. operates as a general contractor for remodels, managing diverse projects and ensuring seamless execution across all trades involved in your home renovation.
